observations: Three manual hydraulic pallet jacks are shown outdoors on a concrete floor.
The jacks have yellow painted metal forks and black handles.
The hydraulic rams and wheels are visible.
The photo contains a watermark 'PREYE DOUGLAS77'.
The photo is taken from a distance, showing the jacks in a cluttered environment.

claims.evidence: The photo shows the item but cannot confirm its weight capacity or structural strength.
No capacity plate or label is visible in the photo to confirm the tonnage.
The design with hand-operated levers and no power source confirms this.
The forks and handle design are characteristic of a pallet jack.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The hydraulic ram may be leaking fluid or the seals may be worn.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the ram and a video of it being operated.

risks.risk: The forks may be cracked, bent, or have deep surface rust.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the fork tines and the underside of the forks.

risks.risk: The wheels may be flat or the bearings may be seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the wheels rolling freely.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any label, plate or sticker showing the brand and model.
Photo of the capacity rating (e.g., 2.5 Ton) stamped on the forks or frame.
Video of the hydraulic ram being operated to check for leaks and smooth operation.
Photos of the fork tines and the underside of the forks to check for cracks or rust.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
